filesystem_authority: UID 0; secret directory 0700, manifest/snapshot files 0600; exact ownership/no symlink/hard-link substitution; data is JSON encoded and never shell-sourced
transport_authority: Linux Unix socket; fixed relay UID verified with SO_PEERCRED; root broker verified by client; no TCP, module, file path or shell RPC
save: save_activate(expected_revision,patch) publishes one manifest with new active revision; interruption leaves entire old/new configuration; no saved-only candidate
retention: Only active configuration and genuine pinned in-flight revisions retained. MAX_SNAPSHOTS derives from MAX_PINS; serialized state bounded by MAX_FILE. Idle failures release pins; stopped ledger entries retain pending-release references until idempotent release acknowledges, and routine cleanup/restart compensates failures or lost replies. Reconciliation excludes stopped references rather than restoring their snapshots. GC removes unneeded old secret files. Startup reconciliation automatic from current-version ledger, not an operator history proof.
public_views: Secrets omitted, configured booleans only; read_snapshot requires the durable task pin
test_policy: Explicit core ownership override only in isolated synthetic fixtures. Production serve never accepts ownership or TLS bypass arguments.
